meta.title: Joseph Franck Onambele-Bekono | Independent Business Consultant, Douala
meta.description: Independent business consultant in strategy, digital transformation and finance, advising executives across Cameroon, Africa and international markets.

hero.headline: I turn ambiguous business problems into *executable strategy.*
hero.lede: I advise founders, SMEs, enterprises and public-sector leaders in strategy, digital transformation and finance. I define the real problem first, build the strategy second, then recommend solutions, with or without technology, that create lasting value.

items.title: Who I serve
items.text: Founders, startups and SMEs first; also large enterprises and public-sector bodies. My counterparts are typically the Board, CEO, CTO, CFO or COO.

items.title: What I do
items.text: I define the real business problem, build the strategy, and recommend prioritized, executable solutions across strategy, finance, product and digital transformation.

items.title: How I work
items.text: Diagnosis before prescription, strategy before solution, and every recommendation tied to long-term, measurable value.

expertise.title: Nine domains, organized around three questions.
expertise.intro: Where should the business go? How is the ambition funded and structured? How does the strategy get built, run and sold?

items.title: Business Strategy & Management

items.title: Corporate Advisory

items.title: Business Analysis & Requirements Engineering

items.title: Project Finance & Corporate Finance

items.title: Digital Transformation & AI Integration

items.title: Product Ownership & Management

items.title: Process Optimization & Operational Excellence

items.title: Product Marketing & Sales Enablement
items.text: Positioning, messaging and tools that help sales teams win.

industries.title: Eleven sectors, one consistent method.
industries.intro: Sector context shapes the diagnosis. It never replaces it.

statement.quote: I bring both the hard-skill rigor of a business analyst and the soft-skill authority of a strategic advisor, closing the gap between where a business is and where it needs to be.

approach.title: Six principles on every engagement.
approach.intro: They apply whatever the sector, and whatever the size of the client.

principles.title: Diagnosis first
principles.text: I never prescribe before I understand. Every engagement starts with deep discovery: context, stakeholders, data and constraints.

principles.title: Strategy before solution
principles.text: I build the strategy first, then recommend solutions aligned to it. Never the reverse.

principles.title: Sustainable value
principles.text: Every recommendation must create long-term, measurable business value.

principles.title: Plain language
principles.text: Complex analysis, translated into clear, decision-ready language for executives.

principles.title: Integrity & objectivity
principles.text: Findings presented honestly, even when they are uncomfortable. I have no agenda beyond the client’s success.

principles.title: Confidentiality
principles.text: All client information is strictly confidential unless disclosure is explicitly authorized.

process.title: Six phases, each ending in a defined deliverable.
process.intro: Every engagement follows the same lifecycle, so progress is visible and decisions are documented.

agile.title: Agile / Scrum, where it fits
agile.text: For product development, digital transformation and other iterative work, I apply Scrum: defined sprints, backlog prioritization, sprint reviews and retrospectives. As Product Owner or Scrum Coach, I keep the backlog aligned to business value and strategy.

clients.title: I work with the people accountable for the outcome.
clients.intro: From a first venture to a business in transformation, in Cameroon, across Africa and beyond.

deliverables.intro: Conclusion first, clearly structured, and ready to use without rework.

items.title: Presentations & decks

items.title: Market & competitor research
items.text: Insight-led, data-backed, with findings you can act on.

items.title: Planning & alignment documents

items.title: Prioritized work lists
items.text: MoSCoW or WSJF-weighted, with an owner assigned and a clear deadline.

standards: Recommendation first. Every formal document opens with an executive summary.
Every recommendation is tied to the client’s strategy and states its expected business impact.
Impact is quantified wherever the data allows: percentages, timelines, revenue and cost.
Research cites its sources, flags data quality and separates facts from estimates.
Proofread rigorously, with zero tolerance for typos. Delivered in English, or in French for Francophone clients.

terms.title: How an engagement is governed.
terms.intro: Clear terms up front, and a clear position on AI.
engagement: Scope, fees and deliverables are agreed in writing before any work begins.
Conflicts of interest are disclosed before an engagement is accepted.
Client information is strictly confidential and never shared with third parties without written consent.
Client work is published only with the client’s written consent.
I comply with applicable laws and regulations in Cameroon, across Africa and internationally.
My assessments are honest: I flag uncertainty and never over-promise on capabilities or outcomes.

ai.title: AI-assisted. Human-validated.
ai.text: AI is a high-performance working partner in my practice, not a replacement for strategic judgment.
points: It accelerates research synthesis, drafting, structuring and analysis.
I review, refine and validate every AI-assisted output before it reaches a client.
Client data is anonymized or handled under applicable confidentiality terms before it touches an AI tool.
Your context and local market knowledge always override generic AI output.

contact.title: Let’s start with the problem.
contact.text: Describe the business problem, the decision in front of you, or the ambition you want to pursue. We start with the diagnosis.
